1021.description: Raise a leg forward against a band loop. It targets the hip flexors and front thigh.
instructions: Loop a band around your ankles or one ankle and anchor it.
Stand tall and hold a support if needed.
Lift one straight leg forward to hip height.
Lower slowly.
Complete reps, then switch legs.

1149.description: Lowering your head toward the handles then pushing out, a strap extension that hammers the triceps.
instructions: Hold the handles and lean forward with arms straight.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Bend your elbows and lower your forehead between the hands.
Keep elbows pointing forward.
Press back up to straight arms.
Move your feet back for more challenge.

1213.description: A cable press performed upward or downward in a vertical line while holding the core still. It trains anti-rotation and shoulder stability.
instructions: Set a cable at a high or low position and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands.
Press the handle straight up (or down) along a vertical line.
Hold for a second without letting your torso twist.
Return to your chest, finish the set, then switch sides.

1277.description: A dumbbell fly done lying back on a stability ball. The unstable surface makes your core work while the chest does the opening and closing.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Walk your feet forward and roll your body down until your head, neck, and upper back are supported by the ball.
Extend your arms straight up above your chest, palms facing each other.
Bend your elbows slightly and lower your arms out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Pause for a moment, then reverse the movement and squeeze your chest muscles as you bring the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，每只手各握一个哑铃。
双脚向前走，身体向下滚动，直到头部、颈部和上背部得到球的支撑。
将双臂伸直至胸部上方，手掌相对。
稍微弯曲肘部，将手臂以宽弧线向两侧放低，直到感觉到胸部有拉伸感。
暂停片刻，然后反向运动并挤压胸部肌肉，同时将​​哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1341.description: Lie back over a stability ball to open up and stretch the lower back. It is a gentle, supported way to ease tightness.
instructions: Sit on the stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Slowly walk your feet forward, rolling the ball down your back until your lower back is resting on the ball.
Place your hands behind your head or cross them over your chest.
Engage your core and slowly lower your upper body towards the ground, allowing your lower back to stretch over the ball.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
慢慢地向前移动你的脚，将球沿着你的背部滚动，直到你的下背部靠在球上。
将双手放在脑后或交叉放在胸前。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将你的上半身降低到地面，让你的下背部伸展到球上方。
保持伸展几秒钟，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1405.description: A stretch for the chest and front of the shoulder with your arms reached behind you. It opens up the pecs and lats.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, parallel to the ground.
Cross your arms in front of your body, with your right arm over your left arm.
Interlock your fingers and rotate your palms away from your body.
Slowly raise your arms up and away from your body, feeling a stretch in your back and chest.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, then release.
Repeat on the opposite side.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将双臂伸直在身前，与地面平行。
双臂交叉在身体前方，右臂放在左臂上方。
手指交叉，手掌旋转远离身体。
慢慢抬起手臂并远离身体，感觉背部和胸部有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒，然后放松。
在另一侧重复。

1469.description: An easier side plank with the bottom knee bent, building oblique and hip stability.
instructions: Lie on your side with your forearm under your shoulder and your knees bent.
Stack your hips and shoulders in a line.
Lift your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line from knee to head.
Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.
Hold for the planned time, then switch sides.

1533.description: The full snatch, lifting the bar from the floor to overhead in one motion and catching it in a deep squat.
instructions: Grip the bar wide, with it over your mid-foot, flat back and chest up.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull under the bar and catch it overhead in a full squat, then stand up.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

1597.description: A stiff-legged deadlift using the smith machine bar. The fixed path lets you focus on feeling the hamstrings work.
instructions: Stand close to the smith bar with feet hip-width apart and grip the bar overhand.
Unrack it and keep your knees nearly straight.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs.
Lower until you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes to stand tall.

1661.description: A dumbbell curl lying on your back. It isolates the biceps with your upper arms supported.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your back and head supported, and your feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing up and your arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，背部和头部得到支撑，双脚平放在地面上。
每只手握住一个哑铃，手掌朝上，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1725.description: An incline triceps extension with a rope on a cable. It stretches and builds the triceps.
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and adjust the incline bench to a comfortable angle.
Stand facing away from the pulley with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the rope with an overhand grip and extend your arms straight overhead.
Keep your elbows close to your head and your upper arms stationary throughout the exercise.
Lower the rope behind your head by bending your elbows until your forearms touch your biceps.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将绳子连接到高滑轮上，并将倾斜长凳调整到舒适的角度。
背对滑轮站立，双脚与肩同宽。
正手抓住绳子，并将双臂伸直过头顶。
在整个练习过程中，保持肘部靠近头部，上臂保持静止。
弯曲肘部，直到前臂接触二头肌，将绳子降低到头后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1789.description: Lying down with your arms out, a partner gently presses your arms toward the floor. It stretches the chest and the front of the shoulders.
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms stretched out straight to the sides or overhead.
Have your partner gently press your wrists or arms down toward the floor.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1917.description: A standing forward fold with the legs crossed, which shifts the stretch to the back of the rear leg.
instructions: Stand tall and cross one foot over the other.
Hinge forward at the hips and reach toward the floor until the back of the thighs stretch.
Keep both legs fairly straight and let your head hang relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1981.description: A cross-body shoulder stretch with the elbow bent, easing the back of the shoulder.
instructions: Stand tall and bring one arm across your chest with the elbow bent.
Hold the elbow with your other hand.
Gently pull the elbow toward the opposite shoulder.
Keep your shoulders level and your neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2109.description: A kneeling backbend that opens the front of the torso.
instructions: Kneel with your knees hip width apart and place your hands on your lower back.
Push your hips forward and lean back until the abdominal muscles stretch.
Tuck your chin a little and avoid dropping your head back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2301.description: A martial arts kick with the back leg that swings in an arc to strike with the heel, training hip mobility and control.
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Shift your weight onto the lead foot.
Lift the rear knee and extend the leg across the target.
Hook the heel around in an arc.
Bring the leg back under control.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch sides.

2365.description: A pullover with straight arms that stretches and works the lats and chest.
instructions: Lie on a bench with your upper back supported and hold a dumbbell over your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight with a slight bend in the elbows.
Lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head until you feel a stretch.
Keep your ribs down and your hips stable.
Pull the dumbbell back over your chest using your lats.
Repeat with control.

2429.description: A crunch that curls your upper body up with your knees bent. Works the abs.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2749.description: A machine leg press with assistance, building the thighs and glutes with a controlled path.
instructions: Sit in the machine and place your feet on the platform about shoulder width apart.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the platform by bending your knees until they reach about 90 degrees.
Push through your heels to extend the legs.
Do not lock your knees fully.

2877.description: A rolling Pilates exercise that massages the spine and builds ab control.
instructions: Sit balanced on your tailbone with knees open and hands inside your ankles.
Tuck your chin and round your back into a ball.
Roll back to your shoulders and clap your feet together.
Roll up to the balance position and clap again.
Keep the roll smooth and avoid rolling onto your neck.

2941.description: Sliding your forearms up a wall to wake up the shoulder blade muscles. It improves overhead movement.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your forearms on it, elbows at shoulder height.
Lean in slightly and keep your abs braced.
Slide your forearms up the wall as you reach upward.
Pause at the top without arching your back.
Slide back down and repeat.

3197.description: A light, springy trot with high knees, like a pony. It's a fun cardio warm-up.
instructions: Stand tall and relaxed.
Move forward in a bouncy trot.
Lift each knee up with a springy step.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Swing your arms in rhythm.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.

3325.description: An alternating band row with a rotation, training your back and the muscles that twist your trunk.
instructions: Anchor a band in front of you at low height and hold both handles.
Stand in a staggered stance with arms extended.
Pull one handle back toward your hip while rotating your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.

3389.description: A sit-up with your feet or legs supported on a chair to focus on the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back and rest your lower legs on a chair seat, knees bent.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands by your ears.
Curl your torso up toward your knees.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower back down slowly.
Do not pull on your neck.

3517.description: A gentle backbend that stretches the spine, hips and abs.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Place your hands on your lower back.
Squeeze your glutes and push your hips forward.
Lean back gently, lifting your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return upright slowly.

3581.description: A lunge followed by lifting the back leg, working the glutes and balance.
instructions: Stand tall and step one leg forward into a lunge.
Lower until both knees reach about 90 degrees.
Press up and lift the rear leg behind or beside you.
Hold briefly with your core tight.
Lower and repeat, then switch sides.

3645.description: A single leg glute bridge with the other leg held straight out. It trains the glutes and hamstrings and tests the core.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Extend one leg straight out in front of you.
Engage your glutes and lift your hips off the ground, forming a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Hold for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
instructionsZh: 仰卧，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将一条腿伸直在您面前。
收紧臀部并将臀部抬离地面，从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在顶部保持片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

3709.description: A squat with dumbbells held locked out overhead. It builds leg strength and demands strong shoulders and core.
instructions: Press two dumbbells overhead with your arms straight.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Sit down into a squat while keeping the weights above your head.
Keep your chest up and ribs down.
Stand back up, driving through your heels.

3773.description: A single-leg hip hinge with a one-arm band row. It challenges your balance and trains hamstrings, glutes and back.
instructions: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand on one leg with a soft knee and the band under light tension.
Hinge forward at the hips while the free leg extends behind you.
Keep your back flat, then pull the handle to your ribs.
Lower the handle and stand tall again. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

3965.description: A bear crawl moving sideways on hands and toes. It builds shoulder stability, core control and leg endurance.
instructions: Get on hands and toes with knees just off the floor.
Keep your back flat.
Step the hand and foot on one side out, then bring the other pair along.
Move several steps one way, then return.
Stay low and keep your hips steady.

4029.description: Standing leg movement against a band that squeezes the thigh inward. It strengthens the inner thigh.
instructions: Anchor the band low and loop it around the ankle nearest the anchor.
Stand tall and hold a support for balance.
Pull the working leg across in front of the other leg.
Pause for a moment and return slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

4093.description: An ab wheel rollout where a wall stops the wheel, making it a safer way to train your abs and core.
instructions: Kneel facing a wall with the ab wheel on the floor in front of you.
Grip the handles and tuck your pelvis under.
Roll forward until the wheel touches the wall.
Pull the wheel back by contracting your abs.
Keep your back flat and avoid sagging at the hips.

4157.description: A seated triceps move where the dumbbells go from the chest outward in front and back. It hits the triceps from a unique angle.
instructions: Sit upright holding dumbbells above your chest, palms facing your feet.
Keep your upper arms close to your torso.
Lower the weights with elbows flared until they touch your chest.
Extend your elbows to push the weights up and slightly forward.
Return to the start in a controlled path.
Keep your back straight and avoid arching.

4221.description: Using a handheld roller on the back of your thigh to loosen tight hamstrings. It works well before or after leg training.
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg extended.
Hold the roller by both handles on the back of your thigh.
Roll from the knee toward your hip with steady pressure.
Slow down on tight spots.
Keep breathing and keep the leg relaxed.
Switch legs after 30-60 seconds.

4349.description: A one-legged squat with a barbell on your back. It builds leg strength and balance, so use light weight.
instructions: Rest a barbell on your upper back and stand on one leg, other leg lifted in front.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and lower as deep as you control.
Drive through your heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

4477.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the iliacus area at the inner hip bone. A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your iliacus area at the inner hip bone while lying face down.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Use gentle pressure and breathe slowly so your stomach stays relaxed.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4541.description: A kettlebell squat-to-press combo done with one arm that works the legs, shoulders and core in one flow.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in the rack position at one shoulder, feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your torso upright and elbow close to your body.
Stand up powerfully through your heels.
Press the kettlebell overhead as you rise, finishing with a straight arm.
Lower it back to the rack and go into the next squat.
Switch arms after your set.

4605.description: A simple hinge pattern drill using a pipe along your spine to check posture while you bend at the hips.
instructions: Hold a PVC pipe vertically along your spine, one hand at the neck and one at the lower back.
Keep the pipe touching head, upper back and tailbone.
Push your hips back with soft knees and tip forward.
Stop when you feel the hamstrings stretch, then squeeze your glutes to stand.
Keep the pipe contact the whole time.

4669.description: A hip thrust from a kneeling position. It works the glutes and teaches strong hip extension.
instructions: Kneel upright with your hips over your knees and your arms by your sides.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Drive your hips forward, squeezing your glutes.
Stand tall at the top without leaning back.
Return slowly and repeat.

4733.description: A leg curl lying on a decline bench with a dumbbell gripped between your feet. It isolates the hamstrings.
instructions: Lie face down on a decline bench with the dumbbell held between your feet.
Let your legs hang straight with your hips pressed to the bench.
Curl your heels up toward your glutes.
Squeeze at the top without lifting your hips.
Lower slowly to full extension.

4797.description: A squat where you hold onto something for balance. It is a friendly way to practise depth and build leg strength.
instructions: Stand holding a stable support at about chest height, feet shoulder width apart.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.
Go as deep as you can with your heels down.
Push through your feet to stand back up.
Use the support for balance, not to pull yourself up.

4861.description: A hip hinge with a kettlebell. It builds the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees.
Push your hips back and lower the bell along your legs.
Keep your back flat.
Squeeze your glutes to stand.

4989.description: Hold a V sit and punch across your body. You train the abs and obliques while balancing.
instructions: Sit with knees bent and lean back, lifting your feet off the floor.
Raise your fists in front of your chest.
Punch one arm across your body while twisting your torso.
Return to center and punch with the other arm.
Keep your chest tall and your balance steady.

5309.description: Combine a sit-up with an overhead press using an EZ bar. Trains the abs, shoulders and triceps in one flowing rep.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding the EZ bar at your chest.
Sit up while keeping the bar close to your body.
Once upright, press the bar overhead.
Lower the bar back to your chest.
Roll back down slowly to the floor.
Brace your core and avoid yanking with your neck.

5373.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the forearm. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with the roller held against it.
Place the roller under the forearm and let your body weight settle onto it.
Lean in and roll your forearm up and down the roller.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5821.description: From a kneeling position, rotate your forearm up and then press overhead on a cable. It trains shoulder rotation and stability.
instructions: Kneel next to a cable with your elbow at shoulder height and bent 90 degrees.
Hold the handle and brace your core.
Rotate your forearm upward until it points to the ceiling.
Press the handle overhead.
Reverse the movement slowly and switch sides.

5885.description: A seated cross-legged breathing practice that calms the mind and lengthens the spine while the hips stay open.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs crossed and each foot resting on the opposite thigh if comfortable.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.
Inhale slowly through your nose and fill your belly and chest.
Exhale slowly and fully.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and breathe steadily for 1-2 minutes.

6013.description: A dynamic kick that warms up the hamstrings and hip flexors and builds coordination.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Kick one straight leg up in front of you.
Lower it under control.
Switch legs in a smooth rhythm.
Keep your torso upright.

6077.description: A circular movement of a bottle around your head. It warms up the shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Stand tall holding a bottle at chest height with both hands.
Circle it around your head, staying close.
Keep your core braced and ribs down.
Complete the circle back to the front.
Reverse direction on the next set.

6141.description: A standing dumbbell press that uses a drive from the legs and trunk. It builds shoulder strength and power.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell at your shoulder.
Bend your knees slightly.
Drive up through your legs and press the dumbbell overhead.
Lock out without leaning back.
Lower the weight to your shoulder.
Switch arms after your set.

6269.description: A standing wrist roll with a cable handle. It builds forearm strength.
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine.
Hold the handle with straight arms.
Roll your wrists up.
Roll them back down.
Repeat smoothly.
Keep your arms still.

7229.description: From a plank you slide a kettlebell under your body from one hand to the other. It works the core and shoulder stability.
instructions: Start in a high plank with a kettlebell beside one hand.
Spread your feet wide for balance.
Grab the kettlebell and slide it across under your body.
Place it down on the other side.
Keep your hips level and repeat in the other direction.

7549.description: Rear-foot elevated split squat with a dumbbell held at the chest.
instructions: Place your rear foot on a bench and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Step the front foot forward.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso tall.
Push through the front heel and switch legs after your reps.

8189.description: A chin-up with a wider underhand grip. It hits the lats and biceps.
instructions: Hang from a bar with an underhand grip wider than shoulders.
Brace your core.
Pull until your chin is over the bar.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

8701.description: A walking lunge carrying a weighted bag, building the legs, glutes and core.
instructions: Hold the bag at your chest or on your shoulders.
Stand tall.
Step forward and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg forward.
Continue, alternating legs.

9213.description: A floor press with the arms kept straight. It trains the chest and shoulders without a big range of motion.
instructions: Lie on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Keep your arms straight and your wrists strong.
Lower your arms slightly and then press back up.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Keep your feet planted and core tight.
Control the weights through each rep.

10045.description: Lying face down, you sweep your arms and legs like a snow angel. It works the muscles along your back.
instructions: Lie face down with arms by your sides and legs together.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Sweep your arms out and overhead while opening your legs.
Bring them back to the start in the same arc.
Repeat in a smooth rhythm.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.

10109.description: A backward throw of a medicine ball over the head from a squat. It builds hip and back power.
instructions: Stand holding a medicine ball in front of your thighs.
Squat down and swing the ball between your legs.
Drive up and extend your hips.
Throw the ball up and backward over your head.
Retrieve the ball and reset.
Keep your arms long and make sure the space behind you is clear.

10557.description: Seated, you tilt your ear toward each shoulder. It eases side neck tightness.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly tilt your head so your ear moves toward one shoulder.
Return to the centre.
Tilt toward the other shoulder.
Repeat for several slow reps.

10749.description: Walk while kicking each leg up. It warms the legs.
instructions: Stand tall.
Step forward and kick the opposite leg up.
Alternate legs.
Swing your arms.
Continue for the set time.

10877.description: A second take on the overhead plate crunch. It trains the abs with a long, loaded lever.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet planted.
Hold a plate with straight arms overhead.
Crunch up, lifting your shoulder blades off the floor.
Keep your arms by your ears as you rise.
Lower back down slowly and repeat.

11261.description: A standing curl with a rope on a low cable. The rope lets you turn your hands at the top for a stronger squeeze.
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold it with palms facing each other.
Stand tall with your elbows at your sides.
Curl the rope up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging your body.

11645.description: Seated or lying with your leg straight, you tighten the thigh muscle and hold, an easy way to activate the quads.
instructions: Sit or lie with one leg straight in front.
Relax your upper body.
Tighten the front of the thigh and press the knee down.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Relax fully.
Repeat, then switch legs.

0061.description: A lying triceps extension with the bar, bending only at the elbows. A staple triceps exercise.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your head at the end of the bench.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart, and extend your arms straight up over your chest.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, slowly lower the barbell towards your forehead by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then extend your arms back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，头放在长凳的末端。
正手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
保持上臂静止，弯曲肘部，慢慢将杠铃降低到前额。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将手臂伸回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0125.description: A wrist curl with palms up, resting the forearms on a bench. Builds the forearm flexors.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent.
Hold a barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Rest your forearms on your thighs, allowing your wrists to hang off the edge.
Slowly curl your wrists upward, bringing the barbell towards your forearms.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲。
反手握住杠铃，手掌朝上，双手与肩同宽。
将前臂放在大腿上，让手腕悬在边缘。
慢慢向上弯曲手腕，将杠铃拉向前臂。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0189.description: A one-arm cable row from a hinged position. It trains the back one side at a time and shows up any strength imbalance.
instructions: Stand facing a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Grasp the cable handle with one hand, palm facing inward, and extend your arm fully.
Pull the cable handle towards your body, keeping your elbow close to your side, until your hand reaches your lower chest.
Pause for a moment, then slowly extend your arm back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 面向缆绳机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
用一只手抓住电缆手柄，手掌朝内，然后完全伸展手臂。
将电缆手柄拉向身体，保持肘部靠近身体一侧，直到手到达下胸部。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂伸回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

0253.description: A chin-up on a bar with a narrow parallel grip and the palms facing in. It works the lats, upper back and biceps.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a narrow parallel grip, palms facing towards you.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 用狭窄的平行握距悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌朝向您。
收紧背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃杆，保持肘部靠近身体。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0317.description: An incline dumbbell curl on a bench. Your arms hang behind the body to stretch the biceps.
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward and arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在上斜凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0381.description: You step back into a lunge while holding dumbbells. It works the glutes and thighs with less knee strain than a forward lunge.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Take a step backward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
Bend your left knee and lower your body until your left thigh is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, stepping back with your left foot.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
右脚向后退一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
弯曲左膝并降低身体，直到左大腿与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后推动左脚跟回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复，左脚向后退一步。

0445.description: An EZ-bar press with a gravity-fighting path that works the shoulders and triceps. Keep the movement smooth and controlled.
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding the ez barbell with an overhand grip.
Raise the barbell to shoulder height, keeping your elbows slightly bent and your palms facing forward.
Press the barbell overhead, extending your arms fully.
Lower the barbell back to shoulder height and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先，双脚分开与肩同宽站立，并用正手握住杠铃。
将杠铃举至肩膀高度，保持肘部稍微弯曲，手掌朝前。
将杠铃推过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
将杠铃降低回肩部高度，然后重复所需的重复次数。

0573.description: On a machine, you extend your torso against a pad to work the lower back. Also brings in the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Adjust the machine to fit your body size and range of motion.
Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet secured.
Place your hands on the handles or grip bars.
Engage your core and slowly lean forward, allowing your back to round slightly.
Pause for a moment at the bottom position, feeling a stretch in your lower back.
Using your back muscles, slowly raise your torso back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整机器以适合您的身体尺寸和运动范围。
坐在机器上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚固定。
将手放在手柄或握杆上。
启动你的核心并慢慢向前倾斜，让你的背部稍微弯曲。
在底部位置暂停片刻，感觉下背部有拉伸感。
使用背部肌肉，慢慢将躯干抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0637.description: Holding an Olympic barbell overhead, you bend and straighten your elbows. Isolates the triceps.
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding the barbell with an overhand grip.
Raise the barbell above your head, fully extending your arms.
Keeping your upper arms close to your head, slowly lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先，双脚分开与肩同宽站立，并用正手握住杠铃。
将杠铃举过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
保持上臂靠近头部，弯曲肘部，慢慢将杠铃降低到脑后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0701.description: An easier side plank with the knees bent. It builds the obliques and side stability.
instructions: Lie on your side with your knees bent.
Place your forearm under your shoulder.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Keep your body in a straight line from knees to head.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch sides.

0765.description: A seated overhead press on the smith machine, with the back supported. It builds the shoulders and triceps along a fixed path.
instructions: Adjust the seat height so that the handles are at shoulder level.
Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and lift them off the supports, extending your arms fully.
Lower the handles down to shoulder level, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Press the handles up overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the handles back down to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，使手柄与肩部齐平。
坐在机器上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住手柄，将其提离支撑物，充分伸展双臂。
将手柄降低至肩部水平，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
将手柄向上推过头顶，直到手臂完全伸展。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手柄放回至肩部水平。
重复所需的重复次数。

0829.description: Walking while lifting your knees high. It warms up the legs and gets your heart pumping.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms relaxed.
Lift one knee to hip height.
Step down and lift the other knee.
Swing your arms naturally.
Keep a steady rhythm for the set duration.

0893.description: A bent-over raise to the sides with a band. It focuses on the rear delts.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends in each hand.
Hinge forward with a flat back.
Raise your arms out to the sides with slightly bent elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly.

0957.description: A deep lunge with a twist and hands pressed together. It strengthens the legs and wrings out the spine.
instructions: Step into a long lunge with the back heel lifted.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist your torso and hook the opposite elbow outside the front knee.
Press your palms together and look up or ahead.
Hold for 3 to 5 breaths, then switch sides.
